vulnerability.name: GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99
vulnerability.description: esbuild enables any website to send any requests to the development server and read the response

statements.impact_statement: esbuild 0.18.7 is a build-time-only transitive dependency of @vinxi/plugin-mdx, used solely for MDX-to-JS transform during the build. The advisory affects esbuild's development server (`esbuild serve`), which this project never starts. The vulnerable code is therefore never in the execution path. There is no fix reachable by upgrade: @vinxi/plugin-mdx 3.7.2 (the latest release) pins esbuild to exactly 0.18.7, and a bun override would downgrade vite's own newer esbuild copies.

braces 3.0.3 is a dev/build-time transitive of vinxi (via micromatch/fast-glob). It expands glob patterns from project config only, never untrusted input, and is absent from the .output production bundle.

node-forge 1.4.0 is a dev-server transitive of vinxi (via listhen/@vinxi/listhen). listhen uses it only to generate self-signed certificates and keys; it never verifies RSA signatures. Absent from the .output production bundle.
